_about: §16A of the master spec — 'real known-good outputs, the match-your-own-records gate'. Its own words: 'Any tool/module reprocessing this data must reproduce these; a mismatch means a bug, not a new answer.' Carried here as data so the targets can be checked rather than quoted.
_source: Vastrangam_ERP_Complete_Master.md §16A, the paragraph beginning 'Verified totals from the owner's real files (period Apr-2025 → Jun-2027)'.
_which_files_these_came_from: Karigar_Reports_April_2025_to_June_2027.xlsx together with Stitching_Rates_Master.xlsx. NEITHER HAS EVER BEEN SUPPLIED TO THIS REPOSITORY. Everything the engine has verified was verified against Karigar_Production_and_Payment_Report_FY202527.xlsx, which is a report DERIVED from them and covers a different period, 158 designs and 32 units. The two are not the same dataset and their totals are not expected to match: 30,811 sets against 25,307, 54,436.5 pieces against 59,110, ₹34,27,498.25 against ₹26,90,062. This is recorded in PROJECT_REPORT.md §0.2 as DECISION 2 — OWNER, and it is why the acceptance run below can be written and cannot yet be run.
_what_can_be_checked_today: That the thirteen per-set-type rows add up to the four totals stated beside them. They do, exactly — 143 designs, 25,307 sets, 59,110 pieces, ₹26,90,062 — so the table is internally consistent and was not transcribed with a slip. That is a real check and it is not the acceptance gate; the gate needs the two source files.

karigar._top_karigar_omitted: §16A also names the highest-earning karigar unit and its total. The figure is a real acceptance target and the name is a person's; the repository's own rule is that a person's name and their earnings do not go into a committed file together. The design-level target above tests the same arithmetic without it.
karigar._no_rate_designs_about: Costed ₹0 and flagged, never guessed at. The repository has said 'five designs with no rate' since the first report and never named them; these are the names, from §16A. They are design codes, not people.
